node.title: Re^4: How come @_ gets changed here?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thanks for the info! I remember seeing references to the "the stack isn't refcounted bug" from my casual lurking on P5P - I just checked again and recent references appear to be [https://www.nntp.perl.org/group/perl.perl5.porters/2017/02/msg242906.html|Stack refcount synopsis] and [https://rt.perl.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=114372|perl #114372]. If it's unclear when it'll be fixed, maybe it would make sense to include a blurb about the nature of the bug in the documentation, something like what you wrote here in this thread?
